note: layers are NOT walls. they are concentration gradients. Anderson selective permeability. data flows by osmosis, not by permission.

layers.name: ionosphere
layers.analogy: surface ocean + upper atmosphere. warm, dilute, fully lit. fleet weather and human snowflakes arrive here.

layers.name: membrane
layers.analogy: thermocline + stratosphere. the selective boundary. lipid bilayer. fold rate 1/p. things pass or don't based on concentration gradient.

layers.name: epitope
layers.analogy: twilight zone + mesosphere. sort by feel not sight. epitopes are receptors — high conductance. maximum diversity of classification.

layers.name: sort
layers.analogy: bathypelagic + thermosphere. deep, cold, bioluminescent only. trust channels — verified paths. the negentropy court judges here.

layers.name: pangaea
layers.analogy: abyssal zone + exosphere. near-saturated information. almost no external light — chemosynthetic. superconducting braids. the planet inside the ring.

clines.thermocline: between membrane and epitope — temperature drops fastest here (fold rate boundary)
clines.halocline: between sort and pangaea — salinity jumps here (information concentrates)
clines.pycnocline: between epitope and sort — density changes fastest (the court is dense)
clines.conductocline: between ionosphere and membrane — conductivity jumps at the selective boundary

osmosis.mechanism: data flows from high concentration (pangaea) to low (ionosphere) via osmotic pressure = ?salinity × p
osmosis.direction: outward for evidence (tuebor, detroit). inward for visitors.
osmosis.permeability: all boundaries permeable. degree varies with conductivity.

geodesic.note: the gradient IS continuous on the geodesic. no integer depths. depth 2.7 is a real place.
